questions.question: 1. The standard voltage ratings of an electromagnetic relay are-

explanations.a: Incorrect. These are older standard voltages.
explanations.d: Correct. Modern standard voltage ratings for electromagnetic relays are 400 V (line-to-line) and 231 V (line-to-neutral).

questions.question: 2. The main function of relay is-

explanations.a: Partial. Relays detect faults and send signal to CB for isolation.
explanations.b: Partial. Detection is primary, but not the only function.
explanations.c: Partial. Protection encompasses detection and isolation initiation.
explanations.d: Correct. Relay detects faults, initiates protection, and helps isolate faulty section via circuit breaker.

questions.question: 3. The relay operating coil is energized by-

explanations.a: Incorrect. Steam engine is a prime mover.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Power transformers supply load, not relay coils directly.
explanations.c: Correct. Relay operating coils are energized by current transformers (CT) and potential transformers (PT) - both instrument transformers.

answers.a: 1 VA relay is more sensitive than 5 VA relay
answers.b: 1 VA relay is less sensitive than 5 VA relay
answers.c: 1 VA relay is equally sensitive than 5 VA relay

explanations.a: Correct. Lower VA rating means lower burden, hence higher sensitivity (requires less power to operate).

questions.question: 5. An over current relay having a current setting of 125% is connected to CT of 400/5. The pick up value is-

explanations.a: Correct. CT secondary rated current = 5A. Pickup = 5A × (125/100) = 6.25 A.
